description: This file defines the 'StringTable' class responsible for managing string tables in XLSX file writing, including creating string tables from worksheet cells, writing string tables to XML, and handling rich text formatting and color details.

classes.name: StringTable
classes.description: Handles creation, management, and serialization of string tables for XLSX files, including support for rich text formatting.

methods.name: createStringTable
methods.description: Generates a string table from worksheet cell values, avoiding duplicates and including rich text.

methods.name: writeStringTable
methods.description: Serializes the string table into XLSX-compatible XML format, supporting disk caching.

methods.name: writeRichText
methods.description: Writes rich text elements into XML with proper formatting and styles.

methods.name: writeRichTextForCharts
methods.description: Generates rich text suitable for chart labels with style attributes.

methods.name: flipStringTable
methods.description: Creates a lookup map from string values to their indices in the string table.
